heading: Tell us about your project.
lede: It takes about two minutes. We'll call you back to set up a time to come look. It's free.
helps: Photos of the room, house, or deck

faq.question: What happens after I send this?
faq.answer: We call you to set up a time to come look. The visit is free and takes about half an hour. Then you get a price in writing. Nothing starts until you say yes.

faq.question: Does the estimate cost anything?
faq.answer: No. It's free, even if you don't hire us.

faq.question: Will I get sales calls?
faq.answer: No. We only use your info to get back to you about your job. We never share it.

faq.question: How soon can you start?
faq.answer: It depends on the time of year. Spring and summer fill up first. When we come look, we'll tell you when we can fit you in.

faq.question: What if I only want a price for now?
faq.answer: That's fine. Lots of people are planning ahead. We'll give you a price and won't bug you about it.
